text: My company already gives me 5 lakh health cover, and it covers my parents too. I'll get my own when I'm married or something, right now it's just extra cost.
I'm covered now and can buy later when I need it.

chain.why: It shows that the coverage you currently have is tied to the employer’s group policy and can only be moved into your own name when you leave the group.
It means that a new personal policy would start its waiting periods from zero.
It indicates that a large share of Indian adults already have diabetes or high blood pressure.
It shows that a private‑hospital stay can cost around ₹24,000 out of pocket.

conclusion: Because employer cover is tied to the group policy and a personal policy would restart waiting periods while many adults already have serious conditions and a private hospital stay can cost ₹24,000, delaying purchase leaves you without coverage during the initial waiting period.
